title: xDrip no working Huawei P30 and Huawei SmartWatch 2
body:
Have Huawei P30 ELE-L29, EMUI TME. ES. Version 10.1.0.123;Android 10. Connected to Huawei SmartWatch 2.
Using Freestyle L 2, With MiaoMiao 2. Selected Hardware : Libre Bluetooth,
 SmartWatch Features : Android Wear Integration : send data wear watchface:on; enable wear collect service ×, Force Wear collect:x
Can't collect any readings from MiaoMiao; Bluetooth apparently conects to MiaoMiao(as indicated in Hw P30) . Appreciate your help.
